g.text: Ghee-crisped milk brioche steeped in wild cardamom syrup, crowned with 4-hour reduced laccha rabri,
roasted Afghan pistachios, and certified 99.9% pure 24K edible gold and silver vark.
Stone-ground aged Basmati pudding steeped in pure Pampore saffron, served chilled in earthen kulhads
with green cardamom dust and handpicked Damask rose petal confetti.
"We use only laboratory-certified 99.9% pure silver & gold leaf,
beaten by traditional master artisan families of Old Lucknow."
Pure vegetarian artisanal beating method • Zero chemical adulteration
Handpicked green tea leaves brewed in a brass samovar with cinnamon quills, green cardamom,
crimson saffron strands, and finely sliced toasted almonds. Served piping hot.
Single-estate Assam second-flush orthodox tea leaves slow-simmered with crushed ginger,
cloves, black pepper, and whole milk, aerated high into clay kulhads.
अतिथि देवो भव • ATITHI DEVO BHAVA
"The dining table in Indian heritage is not merely a place of sustenance;
it is an altar of friendship, family, and royal hospitality."
WARM ROSEWATER TOWELS & MUKHWAS PROVIDED COMPLIMENTARY
